pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions (pyramiding) into falling knives or unconfirmed breakout spikes; consecutive entries must be spaced by a minimum ATR threshold.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Zero order execution permitted within 15 minutes of high-impact USD macro news releases; volume confirmation via tick imbalance required.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stops and partial profit sweeps when floating profit hits +$12.00 to guarantee lock-in toward the $15-$30 target profile.
